ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Installer Package Child Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of suspicious child processes from macOS installer package parent process. This includes osascript, JXA, curl and wget amongst other interpreters

sequences.query: ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\/package\\_script\\_service$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\/installer$")) AND (process_path = RGX("\\/sh$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/bash$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/dash$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/python$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/ruby$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/perl$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/php$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/javascript$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/osascript$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/tclsh$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/curl$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/wget$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*preinstall.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*postinstall.*")))
